decisions.name: Analytics meaning, retention and recovery
decisions.context: factory: Decision report-lifecycle. decisions.name: Redirect availability with bounded analytics degradation
decisions.context: factory: Decision redirect-loss. Redirect availability with bounded analytics degradation: Cache miss/unavailability falls back to authority.
